limitations.text: The **filesystem is not isolated** (it can read world-readable files and write `/tmp`); use a container or nsjail for real RL runs.

Network: with network='off' (default) the sandbox silently runs WITHOUT isolation when 'unshare -rn' is unusable (only 'require_off' raises; check result network_isolated). Fork bombs: RLIMIT_NPROC is set only when running as root (child = nobody); as a normal user they are cut off only by the wall-clock kill of the process group
Fork-bomb resistance is unverified: no RLIMIT_NPROC for normal-user runs and no fork-bomb probe in post_training/test_rewards.py (tracked by SQ61's fail-closed gates)

reason: Reward forgery confirmed (quick review 2026-11-23 12:19): solution code that replaces builtins.exec or builtins.compile with a no-op gets full credit (passed 1/1) for a failing test in rewards.run_tests, in both the committed and the working-tree harness; the honest control scores 0/1. Swallowing AssertionError and os._exit(0) do not forge. GRPO stays blocked until SQ373 closes it.

limitations.text: Reward forgery possible: the harness runs the tests with the builtins exec/compile that the solution can replace, so a policy under GRPO could learn to fake passing tests. Blocks GRPO (SQ373).

reason: SQ373 fix (side-quest worker, verified by the main agent 2026-11-23 ~13:10): the re-run probe on the fixed harness scores every forgery 0/1 (exec_noop, compile_noop were 1/1); post_training.test_rewards OK (30 tests incl. 11 forgery cases); evals/sandbox self_test 16/16 with the absolute repo path. Residual risks documented in rewards.py (a worker can imitate its own side of the pipe protocol; object-level __eq__ tampering inside tests). The harness-level GRPO block (SQ373) is lifted; real RL should still add container isolation.
reconcile the ledger with SQ373 (quick review 2026-11-23 13:38, safety)

limitations.text: Update (v0.5.16): the v0.5.7 'reward forgery possible' limitation is resolved for the probed routes. After SQ373 every case in experiments/checks/reward_forgery_probe.py scores 0/1 (after-fix section of results/reward_forgery_probe_2026-11-23.txt), and 11 forgery cases are unit tests in post_training/test_rewards.py. Still open: (a) residual routes documented in rewards.py (a worker imitating its own side of the pipe protocol; object-level __eq__ tampering inside tests); (b) SQ61's resource-budget and descendant-cleanup tests; (c) not a security boundary (C106: world-readable files stay visible). Real RL should add container isolation.
